description: This file defines the 'BuzzFeedFilterParams' class, a data transfer object (DTO) used for filtering parameters related to Buzz feeds in the OrangeHRM system. It extends core filter parameters and includes specific filters such as share creation date, number of likes/comments, and employee number.

classes.name: BuzzFeedFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying filter parameters for Buzz feeds, including sorting options and specific filters like share ID and employee number.

methods.name: getAuthUserEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the authorized user's employee number.

methods.name: setAuthUserEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the authorized user's employee number.

methods.name: getShareId
methods.description: Returns the filter's share ID if set.
